review.note: Official overview explicitly names OpenCode among launched coding-agent terminals. A generic custom launcher is not the sole basis for this named harness mapping.

parallel-runs.rationale: Documented multiple agent terminals; no observed count.

review.note: The overview documents multiple real agent terminals and workstream release prose documents concurrent pieces of work. This establishes concurrency without a measured count, quota or throughput.
Layer creation and landing documentation establishes a separate Git worktree and branch. Worktrees are code separation only; same-layer nodes share files and script stages are not sandboxed.
Native-workspace documentation places agents and project files on the desktop host. Provider model traffic is separate from agent execution location.
Remote-workspace documentation says project, terminals and agents run on the selected Linux SSH host, with WSL separately supported. Paid-only remote access and user-supplied compute are retained.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Scheduled prompts require awake host and running agent.

review.note: Scheduled-routine documentation supports recurring and one-shot prompts with a minimum interval and running-agent requirement. It explicitly does not keep the host awake; no independent cloud scheduler is inferred.

telemetry-default.rationale: Linux download installer reports by default; desktop diagnostics separately documented opt-in. Website analytics excluded from desktop conclusion.

review.note: The exact retained Linux installer report function sends install status unless MAO_NO_INSTALL_REPORT=1, and policy discloses this path. Desktop optional diagnostics are separately opt-in. The final claim also preserves sign-in crash/update counting whose controls are unknown.

telemetry-off-switch.rationale: For the default-on Linux installer reporting path, MAO_NO_INSTALL_REPORT=1 stops requests before launch. Desktop optional diagnostics separately has an in-app toggle; this mapping is scoped to installer reporting.

review.note: The shell report function returns before its HTTP request when MAO_NO_INSTALL_REPORT=1. Accept config-only strictly for that named installer component. The rationale and final OWN-03 text do not claim this disables desktop crash/update counting, website/account analytics or provider traffic.
